race.description: Seabreeze Hotel South West Rocks Showcase Mdn Hcp
race.comment: PRESTIGE FANTASTIC (1) comes up from Victoria and is now in the Tony Ball yard. Has genuine claims despite a plain Echuca run, with his Kyneton fifth giving him a better platform than the last-start margin suggests after he was held up passing the 300m. He is rated strongly at 1250m and strikes a maiden where that should carry weight. TORPEDO TUBE (11) brings the most recent placing of the main hopes, having been second to Rubinsky at Port Macquarie two starts ago before a fair seventh at Scone. He has the right profile to rebound if he can sharpen late. IN AND AWAY (5) resumes off a Grafton run where he was beaten just under three lengths at long odds, and while his 15-start maiden record tempers confidence, he has enough exposed substance to be a genuine danger fresh. SATURN RISING (4) near his top for this and finds an easier contest after he led early before fading to finish eighth at Scone over 1200m in a Super Maiden.
